gmail.name: create_draft
gmail.description: Creates a new draft email in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

to.description: The primary recipients of the email draft.

cc.description: The carbon copy recipients of the email draft.

bcc.description: The blind carbon copy recipients of the email draft.

subject.description: The subject line of the email.

body.description: The main body content of the email draft.

htmlBody.description: The HTML content of the email draft.

replyToMessageId.description: The ID of the message to reply to.

attachments.description: The attachments to include in the email.

id.description: When present, contains the ID of an external attachment that can be retrieved in a separate GetMessageAttachment request.

filename.description: The name of the file to be attached, e.g. "invoice.pdf".

mimeType.description: The field representing a content or media type must use IANA MIME type, https://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml.

content.description: The base64-encoded content of the attachment.

inline.description: If true, this attachment is handled as inline.

gmail.output: Draft { id, subject, threadId, toRecipients[], ccRecipients[], bccRecipients[], plaintextBody, date, htmlBody }
gmail.rest: gmail v1 users.drafts.create (RFC 2822 MIME built client-side; threadId/In-Reply-To from users.messages.get for replyToMessageId)
gmail.note: Tool description says creating drafts with attachments is not supported yet, although the schema has attachments[].

gmail.name: create_label
gmail.description: Creates a new label in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

displayName.description: The display name of the label to create.

textColor.description: The text color of the label, represented as a hex string (e.g., "#000000").

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the label, represented as a hex string (e.g., "#ffffff").

gmail.output: Label { labelId, name, color, threadsTotal, threadsUnread }; LabelColor { textColor, backgroundColor }
gmail.note: Reference page lists no OAuth scopes.

gmail.name: get_message
gmail.description: Retrieves a specific email message from the authenticated user's Gmail account by its unique message ID.

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message to fetch.

messageFormat.description: Specifies the format of the message returned.

gmail.output: Message { id, snippet, subject, sender, toRecipients[], ccRecipients[], date, plaintextBody, attachmentIds[], htmlBody, attachments[], labelIds[] }; AttachmentMetadata { id, mimeType, filename }

gmail.name: get_thread
gmail.description: Retrieves a specific email thread from the authenticated user's Gmail account, including a list of its messages.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread to fetch.

messageFormat.description: Specifies the format of the messages returned within the thread.

gmail.output: Thread { id, messages[] }; Message { id, snippet, subject, sender, toRecipients[], ccRecipients[], date, plaintextBody, attachmentIds[], htmlBody, attachments[], labelIds[] }

gmail.name: label_message
gmail.description: Adds one or more labels to a specific message in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

messageId.description: The ID of the message to add the labels to.

labelIds.description: The IDs of the labels to add.

gmail.name: label_thread
gmail.description: Adds labels to an entire thread in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread to add labels to.

labelIds.description: The unique identifiers of the labels to add.

gmail.name: list_drafts
gmail.description: Lists draft emails from the authenticated user's Gmail account.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of drafts to return.

pageToken.description: A token received from a previous list_drafts call to retrieve the next page of results.

query.description: Gmail search query to filter drafts (for example: subject:Update from:a@b.com newer_than:7d is:unread).

view.description: Controls the fields populated for drafts in the draft list.

gmail.output: ListDraftsResponse { drafts[], nextPageToken }; Draft { id, subject, threadId, toRecipients[], ccRecipients[], bccRecipients[], plaintextBody, date, htmlBody }
gmail.rest: gmail v1 users.drafts.list + users.drafts.get per draft

gmail.name: list_labels
gmail.description: Lists all user-defined labels available in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of labels to return.

pageToken.description: Page token to retrieve a specific page of results in the list.

gmail.output: ListLabelsResponse { labels[], nextPageToken }; Label { labelId, name, color, threadsTotal, threadsUnread }
gmail.rest: gmail v1 users.labels.list (+ users.labels.get for counts)

gmail.name: search_threads
gmail.description: Lists email threads from the authenticated user's Gmail account.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of threads to return.

pageToken.description: Page token to retrieve a specific page of results in the list.

query.description: A query string to filter the threads.

includeTrash.description: Include threads from TRASH in the results.

view.description: Controls the fields populated for threads in the thread list.

gmail.output: SearchThreadsResponse { threads[], nextPageToken, resultCountEstimate }; Thread { id, messages[] }
gmail.rest: gmail v1 users.threads.list (q, includeSpamTrash) + users.threads.get per thread

gmail.name: unlabel_message
gmail.description: Removes one or more labels from a specific message in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

messageId.description: The ID of the message to remove the labels from.

labelIds.description: The IDs of the labels to remove.

gmail.name: unlabel_thread
gmail.description: Removes labels from an entire thread in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread to remove labels from.

labelIds.description: The unique identifiers of the labels to remove.

calendar.name: create_event
calendar.description: Creates an event on the given calendar.

self.description: Whether this entry represents the calendar on which this copy of the event appears.

resource.description: Whether attendee is a resource (for example, room).

responseStatus.description: Response status. Values: needsAction, declined, tentative, accepted.

recurrenceData.description: Recurrence rules as RRULE, RDATE, or EXDATE strings (per RFC 5545).

minutes.description: Minutes in advance that the reminder is triggered.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar to create the event on.

allDay.description: Whether the event spans the entire day.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example, America/Los_Angeles).

notificationLevel.description: Which email notification should be sent for this event update.

addGoogleMeetUrl.description: Create and add a Google Meet URL.

visibility.description: Visibility of the event. Values: default, public, private.

googleMeetUrl.description: Specific Google Meet URL or meeting ID.

guestsCanModify.description: Whether guests can modify the event.

guestsCanSeeGuests.description: Whether guests can see other guests.

workingLocationProperties.description: Working location properties (if eventType is WORKING_LOCATION).

customLocationLabel.description: The label for a custom location.

calendar.output: Event { id, status, htmlLink, created, updated, summary, description, location, creator, organizer, start, end, recurrence[], recurringEventId, originalStartTime, transparency, visibility, attendees[], conferenceUrl, colorId, overrideReminders[], attachments[], guestPermissions, eventType, workingLocationProperties, availability }; Principal { email, displayName, self }; DateOrDateTime { date, dateTime, timeZone }; Attendee { id, email, displayName, organizer, self, resource, optionalAttendee, responseStatus, comment, additionalGuests }; Reminder { method, minutes }; Attachment { fileUrl, title }; GuestPermissions { guestsCanInviteOthers, guestsCanModify, guestsCanSeeGuests }; WorkingLocationProperties { type, customLocationLabel }

calendar.name: delete_event
calendar.description: Deletes an event on the given calendar.

eventId.description: The ID of the event to delete.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar containing the event.

notificationLevel.description: Which email notification should be sent for this event update.

calendar.output: Event { id, status, htmlLink, created, updated, summary, description, location, creator, organizer, start, end, recurrence[], recurringEventId, originalStartTime, transparency, visibility, attendees[], conferenceUrl, colorId, overrideReminders[], attachments[], guestPermissions, eventType, workingLocationProperties, availability }; Principal { email, displayName, self }; DateOrDateTime { date, dateTime, timeZone }; Attendee { id, email, displayName, organizer, self, resource, optionalAttendee, responseStatus, comment, additionalGuests }; Reminder { method, minutes }; Attachment { fileUrl, title }; GuestPermissions { guestsCanInviteOthers, guestsCanModify, guestsCanSeeGuests }; WorkingLocationProperties { type, customLocationLabel }

calendar.name: get_event
calendar.description: Returns a single event on the given calendar.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar containing the event.

calendar.output: Event { id, status, htmlLink, created, updated, summary, description, location, creator, organizer, start, end, recurrence[], recurringEventId, originalStartTime, transparency, visibility, attendees[], conferenceUrl, colorId, overrideReminders[], attachments[], guestPermissions, eventType, workingLocationProperties, availability }; Principal { email, displayName, self }; DateOrDateTime { date, dateTime, timeZone }; Attendee { id, email, displayName, organizer, self, resource, optionalAttendee, responseStatus, comment, additionalGuests }; Reminder { method, minutes }; Attachment { fileUrl, title }; GuestPermissions { guestsCanInviteOthers, guestsCanModify, guestsCanSeeGuests }; WorkingLocationProperties { type, customLocationLabel }

calendar.name: list_calendars
calendar.description: Returns the calendars this user has access to (their calendar list).

pageToken.description: Token specifying which result page to return.

calendar.output: ListCalendarsResponse { calendars[], nextPageToken }; CalendarListItem { id, summary, description, timeZone }

calendar.name: list_events
calendar.description: Returns events on the given calendar matching all specified constraints.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar containing the events.

startTime.description: The lower bound of a time range.

endTime.description: The upper bound of a time range.

timeZone.description: Time zone (IANA ID, for example Europe/Zurich) used to resolve timezone-less dates.

orderBy.description: The order in which events should be returned. Values: default, startTime, startTimeDesc, lastModified.

fullText.description: Free-form case-insensitive search matching title, description, location, or attendees.

calendar.output: ListEventsResponse { summary, description, updated, timeZone, accessRole, defaultReminders[], events[], nextPageToken }; Reminder { method, minutes }; Event { id, status, htmlLink, created, updated, summary, description, location, creator, organizer, start, end, recurrence[], recurringEventId, originalStartTime, transparency, visibility, attendees[], conferenceUrl, colorId, overrideReminders[], attachments[], guestPermissions, eventType, workingLocationProperties, availability }
calendar.rest: calendar v3 events.list (timeMin/timeMax, orderBy, q=fullText, eventTypes, singleEvents)

calendar.name: respond_to_event
calendar.description: Responds to an event on a calendar.

eventId.description: The ID of the event to respond to.

responseStatus.description: The new user's response status of the event. Values: declined, tentative, accepted.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar containing the event.

notificationLevel.description: Which email notification should be sent for this event update.

responseComment.description: The user's comment attached to the response.

calendar.output: Event { id, status, htmlLink, created, updated, summary, description, location, creator, organizer, start, end, recurrence[], recurringEventId, originalStartTime, transparency, visibility, attendees[], conferenceUrl, colorId, overrideReminders[], attachments[], guestPermissions, eventType, workingLocationProperties, availability }; Principal { email, displayName, self }; DateOrDateTime { date, dateTime, timeZone }; Attendee { id, email, displayName, organizer, self, resource, optionalAttendee, responseStatus, comment, additionalGuests }; Reminder { method, minutes }; Attachment { fileUrl, title }; GuestPermissions { guestsCanInviteOthers, guestsCanModify, guestsCanSeeGuests }; WorkingLocationProperties { type, customLocationLabel }
calendar.rest: calendar v3 events.get + events.patch (self attendee responseStatus/comment)

calendar.name: search_events
calendar.description: Searches events on the user's primary calendar using semantic search.

query.description: Query string to search for events (case-insensitive).

pageSize.description: Maximum number of entries returned on one result page.

pageToken.description: Token specifying which result page to return.

calendar.output: SearchEventsResponse { events[], nextPageToken }; Event { id, status, htmlLink, created, updated, summary, description, location, creator, organizer, start, end, recurrence[], recurringEventId, originalStartTime, transparency, visibility, attendees[], conferenceUrl, colorId, overrideReminders[], attachments[], guestPermissions, eventType, workingLocationProperties, availability }
calendar.rest: no direct REST equivalent (semantic search on primary calendar); closest is calendar v3 events.list with q

calendar.name: suggest_time
calendar.description: Suggests time periods across one or more calendars.

attendeeEmails.description: Attendee emails to find free time for.

timeZone.description: Time zone for search times (IANA ID, for example Europe/Zurich).

durationMinutes.description: Min duration of free slot in minutes.

pageSize.description: Max number of slots to return.

calendar.output: SuggestTimeResponse { timeSlots[] }; TimeSlot { startTime, endTime, durationMinutes, start, end }
calendar.rest: calendar v3 freebusy.query + client-side free-slot computation

calendar.name: update_event
calendar.description: Updates an event on the given calendar.

addedAttendees.description: Attendees to add to the event.

self.description: Whether this entry represents the calendar on which this copy of the event appears.

resource.description: Whether attendee is a resource (for example, room).

responseStatus.description: Response status. Values: needsAction, declined, tentative, accepted.

removedAttendeeEmails.description: The attendees of the event to remove, as email addresses.

overrideReminders.description: If set, replaces all existing reminders for the event.

minutes.description: Minutes in advance that the reminder is triggered.

addedAttachments.description: File attachments to add to the event.

removedAttachmentFileUrls.description: File attachments to remove from the event.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar containing the event.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example, America/Los_Angeles).

notificationLevel.description: Email notification to send for this event update.

addGoogleMeetUrl.description: If true, creates or updates a Google Meet URL for the event.

visibility.description: New visibility of the event. Values: default, public, private.

googleMeetUrl.description: Allows attaching an existing Google Meet URL or meeting ID to the event.

guestPermissions.description: Guest permission settings for this event.

guestsCanModify.description: Whether guests can modify the event.

guestsCanSeeGuests.description: Whether guests can see other guests.

availability.description: Whether the event blocks time on the calendar.

calendar.output: Event { id, status, htmlLink, created, updated, summary, description, location, creator, organizer, start, end, recurrence[], recurringEventId, originalStartTime, transparency, visibility, attendees[], conferenceUrl, colorId, overrideReminders[], attachments[], guestPermissions, eventType, workingLocationProperties, availability }; Principal { email, displayName, self }; DateOrDateTime { date, dateTime, timeZone }; Attendee { id, email, displayName, organizer, self, resource, optionalAttendee, responseStatus, comment, additionalGuests }; Reminder { method, minutes }; Attachment { fileUrl, title }; GuestPermissions { guestsCanInviteOthers, guestsCanModify, guestsCanSeeGuests }; WorkingLocationProperties { type, customLocationLabel }

drive.name: copy_file
drive.description: Call this tool to copy an existing File in Google Drive.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to copy.

title.description: The title of the newly created file.

parentId.description: The parent id of the newly created file.

drive.output: File { id, title, parentId, mimeType, fileSize, description, fileExtension, contentSnippet, viewUrl, sharedWithMeTime, createdTime, modifiedTime, viewedByMeTime, owner, canAddChildren }

drive.name: create_file
drive.description: Call this tool to create or upload a File to Google Drive.

contentMimeType.description: The mime type of the content being uploaded.

content.description: The content of the file encoded as base64.

base64Content.description: The base64 encoded content to upload.

parentId.description: The parent id of the file.

disableConversionToGoogleType.description: Set to true to retain the passed in content mime type and not convert to a Google type.

drive.output: File { id, title, parentId, mimeType, fileSize, description, fileExtension, contentSnippet, viewUrl, sharedWithMeTime, createdTime, modifiedTime, viewedByMeTime, owner, canAddChildren }
drive.rest: drive v3 files.create (multipart upload when content given)

drive.name: download_file_content
drive.description: Call this tool to download the content of a Drive file as a base64 encoded string.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

exportMimeType.description: For Google native files, the MIME type to export the file to, ignored otherwise.

drive.rest: drive v3 files.get?alt=media, or files.export for Google-native types

drive.name: get_file_metadata
drive.description: Call this tool to find general metadata about a user's Drive file.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

drive.output: File { id, title, parentId, mimeType, fileSize, description, fileExtension, contentSnippet, viewUrl, sharedWithMeTime, createdTime, modifiedTime, viewedByMeTime, owner, canAddChildren }

drive.name: get_file_permissions
drive.description: Call this tool to list the permissions of a Drive File.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to get permissions for.

drive.output: GetFilePermissionsResponse { permissions[] }; Permission { role, displayName, type, emailAddress, view }

drive.name: list_recent_files
drive.description: Call this tool to find recent files for a user specified a sort order.

orderBy.description: The sort order for the files. Values (from tool description): recency (default), lastModified, lastModifiedByMe.

pageToken.description: The page token to use for pagination.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of files to return.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

drive.output: ListFilesResponse { files[], nextPageToken }; File { id, title, parentId, mimeType, fileSize, description, fileExtension, contentSnippet, viewUrl, sharedWithMeTime, createdTime, modifiedTime, viewedByMeTime, owner, canAddChildren }
drive.rest: drive v3 files.list (orderBy recency / modifiedTime / modifiedByMeTime)

drive.name: read_file_content
drive.description: Call this tool to fetch a natural language representation of a Drive file, and optionally, its comments.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

includeComments.description: Whether to include comments in the response.

drive.output: ReadFileContentResponse { contentAnchoredComments[], unanchoredComments[], fileContent, textFormattingNotSupported, commentsNotSupported }; CommentThread { replies[], commentId, status, headPost }
drive.rest: drive v3 files.export (text/plain, text/csv) or files.get?alt=media; comments.list when includeComments

drive.name: search_files
drive.description: Search Drive files. The query uses Drive's syntax: name contains 'plan', fullText contains 'budget', mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.document', modifiedTime > '2026-01-01T00:00:00', 'FOLDER_ID' in parents, sharedWithMe; title, parentId, and owner work as names for name, parents, and owners. Plain words search the files' text.

query.description: The search query, in Drive's query syntax or as plain words.

pageToken.description: The page token to use for pagination.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of files to return in each page.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

drive.output: SearchFilesResponse { files[], nextPageToken }; File { id, title, parentId, mimeType, fileSize, description, fileExtension, contentSnippet, viewUrl, sharedWithMeTime, createdTime, modifiedTime, viewedByMeTime, owner, canAddChildren }
drive.rest: drive v3 files.list with q (MCP query terms title/parentId/owner/sharedWithMe translated to v3 name/parents/owners/sharedWithMe)
